metadata.description: Plant watering configuration based on the owner's current plant photos

plants.name: Chinese Money Plant
plants.care_notes: Check the soil before watering and water only when the top 2-3 cm is dry. Water thoroughly, empty the outer pot or saucer, and rotate weekly for even growth. Avoid harsh direct afternoon sun.

plants.name: Dragon Tree
plants.care_notes: Water only when the top 3-5 cm of soil is dry, then drain fully. It tolerates slight dryness better than excess water. Use low-mineral or filtered water if leaf tips turn brown and keep away from cold drafts.

plants.name: Never-Never Plant
plants.care_notes: Keep the soil lightly and evenly moist, but never waterlogged. Water when the top 1-2 cm starts to dry. Prefer rainwater or filtered water and provide good humidity; direct sun and dry air cause brown tips.

plants.name: Balcony Plants
plants.care_notes: This reminder covers every balcony pot as one group. Check each pot and water only those whose top 2-3 cm is dry; skip wet pots and reduce watering after rain. The dragon tree and purple tradescantia are cold-sensitive: bring them indoors before nights below about 10 °C and before any frost. Remove dead growth and make sure all pots drain freely.
